body.zh:
P(θ) = P₀ cos²(2θ − φ)

理想半波片、固定检偏器。φ 由入射偏振、检偏器方向及轴零点确定。实际测量还受波长、损耗与探测器响应影响。

任务

改变波片角度，测量透射功率，得到角度—功率曲线。

定义θ 的零点、单位与范围
执行转动 → 到位 → 采集
解释实际角度、功率与校准条件
body.en:
P(θ) = P₀ cos²(2θ − φ)

Ideal half-wave plate and fixed analyzer; φ depends on input polarization, analyzer orientation and axis zero. Wavelength, loss and detector response affect the physical measurement.

Task

Vary the plate angle, measure transmitted power and obtain an angle–power curve.

DefineAngle origin, units and range
ExecuteMove → settle → acquire
InterpretActual angle, power and calibration

title.zh: MHS：把不同设备接到共同能力接口
title.en: MHS: a shared capability interface for heterogeneous devices

status.zh: Anthropic × HHMI Janelia · 研究预览

body.zh:
人 / Agent / 自动化程序MCP · CLI · API
↓
共同设备接口发现设备 · 读状态 · 写控制量
激光器驱动功率、开关
转台驱动角度、位置
相机驱动曝光、图像
物理设备与各自的编程接口

定义

MHS（Model Hardware Standard）用共同驱动接口描述和操作设备。说明标签补充物理特性、使用知识及操作条件。

改变了什么

驱动处理厂商接口差异。Agent 可从 MCP、命令行或 API 调用设备，也可将多仪器动作写成持续执行的程序。

在扫描中

找到能旋转波片的轴和能读取光功率的通道，再通过共同接口操作。

IOP 可沿用能力描述与驱动映射，让同一实验方法使用不同型号的仪器。
body.en:
People / agents / automationMCP · CLI · API
↓
Shared device interfaceDiscover devices · Read state · Write controls
Laser driverPower, enable
Stage driverAngle, position
Camera driverExposure, image
Physical devices and their programming interfaces

Definition

MHS (Model Hardware Standard) exposes devices through shared drivers. Description tags add physical characteristics, operating knowledge and conditions.

What changes

Drivers translate vendor interfaces. Agents use MCP, CLI or APIs, and can compose commands into programs that coordinate multiple instruments.

In the scan

Find an axis that rotates the plate and a channel that measures optical power, then operate both through a common interface.

IOP can reuse capability descriptions and driver mappings so one method can work with different instrument models.

title.zh: Open-MHS 与 MHP：四个项目的实现差异
title.en: Open-MHS and MHP: four implementation choices

status.zh: 三个 Open-MHS 独立维护。Cuntinum MHP 为另一项目

body.zh:
独立项目实现的组织方式具体区别
Open-MHS · Abenor Labs能力标签 → 设备基类 → 传输驱动标签随设备提供。读写检查集中在运行层。支持生成设备说明。
Open MHS · tongriyaotxt设备注册 → 命令分派 → 运动技能在读写之上增加机器人技能，把连续动作交给本地控制。
Open MHS · SCUT-ESA共同接口 → 显式后端 → VISA 仪器分别管理实机、实验性与模拟后端。维护者列出两款 UNI-T 仪器的实机记录。
MHP · Cuntinumdiscover / read / write / execute
+ State Bus		以四类原语组织 SDK 和驱动，用共享状态组织设备协作。包名 khp。

共同点是“能力—驱动”映射。差异在状态共享、动作组织和设备后端。选择依据应落实到所需设备与操作。
body.en:
Independent projectImplementation structureConcrete distinction
Open-MHS · Abenor LabsCapability tags → device base class → transportDevice-owned tags; centralized read/write checks; generated device documentation.
Open MHS · tongriyaotxtRegistry → command dispatch → motion skillsRobot skills add local continuous control above individual reads and writes.
Open MHS · SCUT-ESACommon interface → explicit backend → VISA instrumentSeparates hardware, experimental and simulated backends; reports hardware work with two UNI-T models.
MHP · Cuntinumdiscover / read / write / execute
+ State Bus		Four primitive families organize SDKs and drivers; a shared state bus supports coordination. Package: khp.

The common mechanism is capability-to-driver mapping. State sharing, action composition and device backends distinguish the implementations.

title.zh: AIP：常驻服务与持续操作
title.en: AIP: persistent services and ongoing operations

status.zh: Agent–Instrument Protocol · 用户提供的 PRD v1.1

body.zh:
客户端请求read · write · ramp · act
↓

常驻仪器服务

物理量 / 操作 / 持续活动单位、参数、进度、完成条件
资源与状态操作影响什么 · 活动占用什么
↓ ↑
型号驱动与通信连接下发操作。读取实际状态

定义

AIP（Agent–Instrument Protocol）把仪器连接、长活动与执行记录放进持续运行的服务。客户端提交工作并查询结果。

关键区别

分别记录请求受理和实际完成。每项操作说明会影响哪些资源。读数注明来自仪器、驱动保存的状态，还是计算推得。

在扫描中

转台移动期间，服务持续跟踪到位条件。调用者离开后，活动和观测仍有明确身份。

IOP 可沿用常驻服务、资源声明与操作事件，让实验在多次调用之间持续运行。
body.en:
Client requestread · write · ramp · act
↓

Persistent instrument service

Quantity / action / activityUnits, parameters, progress, completion
Resources and stateOperation effects · Activity resources
↓ ↑
Model driver + communication channelIssue operations; read actual state

Definition

AIP places device connections, long-running activities and execution records in a persistent service. Clients submit work and retrieve results.

Key distinction

Acceptance and physical completion have separate records. Operations declare affected resources. Readings identify device reports, driver-maintained state or calculated values.

In the scan

The service tracks arrival while the stage moves. Activities and observations retain identities beyond the initiating call.

IOP can reuse persistent execution, resource declarations and operation events so experiments continue across client calls.

title.zh: OpenMHP：让设备说明、驱动与运行记录相互关联
title.en: OpenMHP: connect descriptions, drivers and run records

status.zh: 规范草案与 Python 实现 · 参考设备主要在数字孪生环境运行
status.en: Draft specification and Python code · Reference devices primarily run in digital twins

body.zh:
DEVICE.md身份、摘要、操作说明
descriptor.yamlsignals · settings · actions
driver.py读写与动作的设备实现
references / scripts / methods知识材料、过程脚本与方法参数

定义

OpenMHP 用设备包把操作说明、机器可读描述与驱动放在一起，再以统一请求操作设备。

执行路径

device/describe → 选择能力 → 读取 / 写入 / 调用动作 → 查询任务和运行文件

关键区别

每个服务管理一个逻辑设备，长动作作为任务执行。实验脚本可后台运行，并将数据文件关联到 run。设备描述按需读取。

IOP 可沿用设备包的组织方式，将操作说明、驱动、方法与运行数据相互关联。
body.en:
DEVICE.mdIdentity, summary and instructions
descriptor.yamlsignals · settings · actions
driver.pyDevice implementation of reads, writes and actions
references / scripts / methodsReferences, procedures and method parameters

Definition

OpenMHP packages instructions, machine-readable descriptions and drivers, then exposes devices through common requests.

Execution path

device/describe → select capabilities → read / write / invoke → inspect jobs and run files

Key distinction

A server owns one logical device and runs long actions as jobs. Experiment scripts can run in the background and link files to a run. Descriptions load on demand.

IOP can reuse the device-package structure to connect instructions, drivers, methods and run data.

title.zh: LAP：资源预约、任务与测量结果
title.en: LAP: reservations, tasks and measurement results

status.zh: Shiyanjia Lab · LAP v0.1 设计论文
status.en: Shiyanjia Lab · LAP v0.1 design paper

body.zh:
InstrumentCard能力、设备身份与物理限制
↓
Reservation + task设备 / 样品占用，任务状态与参数绑定的执行确认
↓
MeasurementResult数值、单位、校准、不确定度与来源

定义

LAP（Lab Agent Protocol）沿用 A2A 的设备发现与任务结构，增加仪器说明、资源预约、操作确认和测量结果。

在扫描中

取得转台与探测器的使用权。提交扫描任务。返回带角度单位、探测器校准信息及测量来源的结果。

IOP 可沿用任务与结果的关联：测量值同时说明单位、校准、不确定度及产生条件。
body.en:
InstrumentCardCapabilities, identity and physical limits
↓
Reservation + taskDevice/sample reservation, task state and task-bound confirmation
↓
MeasurementResultValues, units, calibration, uncertainty and provenance

Definition

LAP (Lab Agent Protocol) extends A2A discovery and tasks with instrument descriptions, reservations, operation confirmation and measurement results.

In the scan

Reserve the stage and detector, submit a scan task, and return results with angle units, detector calibration and measurement provenance.

IOP can link each task to results that carry units, calibration, uncertainty and acquisition conditions.

title.zh: OAHL：设备节点与使用会话
title.en: OAHL: hardware nodes and access sessions

status.zh: MIT · 节点、SDK 与传输插件
status.en: MIT · Nodes, SDKs and transport plugins

body.zh:
调用者JavaScript / Python SDK
↓
本地节点 / 可选注册与中继发现能力与节点地址
↓
会话管理 → 设备适配器 → 传输Serial · ADB · MQTT · TCP
节点所在位置的真实设备

定义

OAHL（Open Agent Hardware Layer）把设备暴露为节点中的能力，调用者通过会话取得使用权，再由适配器和传输插件执行。

它重点解决什么

节点提供设备地址与能力，会话安排设备使用权。README 展示了通过 ADB 操作手机。IOP 可借鉴节点发现和会话管理。

discover找到设备
reserve取得会话
execute执行能力
release释放占用
body.en:
CallerJavaScript / Python SDK
↓
Local node / optional registry and relayFind capabilities and node addresses
↓
Session → adapter → transportSerial · ADB · MQTT · TCP
Physical equipment attached to the node

Definition

OAHL exposes capabilities through hardware nodes. Callers reserve sessions; adapters and transport plugins perform the operation.

Primary problem

Nodes expose device locations and capabilities. Sessions allocate access. The README demonstrates ADB control of a phone. IOP can reuse node discovery and session management.

discoverFind equipment
reserveAcquire a session
executeRun a capability
releaseRelease the resource

title.zh: 同一次扫描中的三类机制
title.en: Three mechanisms in one polarization scan

status.zh: 偏振扫描 · 机制组合

body.zh:
C

取得可用设备

按旋转轴与功率测量能力找到设备，建立会话，确认资源占用。

设备身份 + 可访问端点
A

建立操作的共同含义

把转台位置定义为半波片角度 θ。把探测器通道定义为光功率 P。

能力 + 单位 + 轴零点
B

执行并保存物理结果

每点设角、确认到位、采集功率。将实际读数与同一次 run 关联。

run → observations

三类机制在一次实验中共同工作。能力说明供程序选择设备，服务安排使用与执行，测量记录保存实际结果。
body.en:
C

Acquire available equipment

Find rotational and power-measurement capabilities, establish a session and reserve resources.

identity + endpoint
A

Establish shared operation meanings

Define the stage position as plate angle θ and the detector channel as optical power P.

capability + unit + origin
B

Execute and retain physical results

Set each angle, confirm arrival and acquire power; associate actual readings with the same run.

run → observations

All three mechanisms contribute to an experiment. Descriptions guide device selection, services arrange access and execution, and measurement records retain the results.

title.zh: 常驻服务：从单台仪器到实验平台
title.en: Persistent service: one device or a whole platform

status.zh: IOP 平台服务设计

body.zh:
人 / Agent 的实验程序提交实验 · 调用操作 · 订阅状态 · 查询结果
↓ ↑

平台常驻服务

统一的设备所有权与执行入口

设备与能力注册表依赖 / 资源调度器活动状态与事件记录
↓ ↑
转台驱动位置与运动
功率计驱动配置与采集
相机驱动曝光与图像

注册与连接

单台或多台仪器都可注册到平台服务，提供设备身份、驱动、说明和连接地址。驱动管理各自设备的连接与读写。

常驻与执行

服务持续运行并管理实验工作进程。每次运行有 run_id。调用者断开后实验继续，重新连接可查询进度和结果。

多平台协作

服务内部可使用多个进程。多个平台各有自己的服务，通过服务间通信协调实验，每台设备由所属平台管理。

Runtime 指实验运行系统。常驻服务由持续运行的守护进程承载，可管理一台仪器或整个平台。
body.en:
Experiment programs from people and agentsSubmit experiments · Invoke operations · Watch state · Retrieve results
↓ ↑

Persistent platform service

One authority for device access and execution

Device and capability registryDependency / resource schedulerActivity state and event records
↓ ↑
Stage driverPosition and motion
Meter driverSettings and acquisition
Camera driverExposure and images

Registration and connections

One device or many can register with a platform service, supplying an identity, driver, description and endpoint. Drivers handle connections and device commands.

Persistent execution

The service stays active and manages experiment workers. Each run has a run_id. Experiments continue after a caller disconnects and remain available on reconnection.

Multiple platforms

A service may use several processes. Each platform has its own service, and services coordinate experiments while retaining local device management.

The runtime executes experiments. Persistent daemon processes host its service and manage device access.

启动条件 = 前置步骤已完成 ＋ 所需物理资源与通信资源可用

独立操作并行

A 与 B 的资源兼容，可同时推进。C 依赖二者，按实际完成事件开始。

冲突资源串行

同一转轴、共享光路或独占连接按资源规则排序。运动期间，其他可用设备继续工作。

扫描点持续保留转轴、光路与探测器，直到采集完成。通信连接按实际通信区间占用。精确同步由设备时钟和硬件触发执行。
body.en:
Start when dependencies are complete and required physical and communication resources are available

Independent work overlaps

A and B use compatible resources and can overlap. C starts after both completion events.

Conflicting access is ordered

Resource rules order access to a shared axis, optical path or exclusive connection. Other available devices continue while motion proceeds.

Reserve the axis, optical path and detector for the whole scan point. Hold connections during exchanges. Device clocks and hardware triggers perform precision synchronization.

title.zh: 实验程序与常驻服务的分工
title.en: Experiment programs and the platform service

status.zh: IOP 客户端接口设计示例

body.zh:
调用者的程序

实验包experiment.py · method.yaml · dependencies.lock

程序组织实验方法

实验包声明能力需求、步骤依赖、循环和条件。服务选择已注册设备，安排工作进程执行程序。

服务组织实际执行

所有设备操作经服务安排，驱动负责下发命令。数据拟合与分析可在客户端或工作进程中完成。

调用者按需参与

人或 Agent 随时查询、分析、提交下一轮或请求停止。当前实验按已提交的方法持续运行。

实验包组织操作与分析。平台服务持续管理设备执行，Agent 根据结果安排下一轮实验。
body.en:
Caller program
platform = IOP.connect("optics-bench-01")
run = platform.submit(
    project="polarization-study",
    package="polarization-scan@0.1",
    parameters={"angles_deg": [0, 15, 30, 45]}
)

for event in platform.watch(run.id):

Experiment packageexperiment.py · method.yaml · dependencies.lock

The program expresses the method

Packages declare capabilities, dependencies, loops and conditions. The service selects registered devices and runs the program in managed workers.

The service organizes execution

The service schedules device operations and drivers issue commands. Fitting and analysis may run in a client or an experiment worker.

Callers participate as needed

People or agents inspect, analyze, submit another run or request a stop. The current experiment continues under its submitted method.

Packages organize operations and analysis. The platform service manages device execution. Agents use the results to plan subsequent experiments.

Method, sample and variables

WhenAutomatically linked information

A shared execution entry point lets the service continuously link research, experiments, runs, operations and data.

title.zh: 方法、实验运行与操作实例

body.zh:
method_id + version同一方法可反复运行，每次运行包含多项操作
对象保存什么偏振扫描中的例子
仪器与操作说明设备身份、操作含义、参数、单位、完成条件与说明版本。转台 move_to 接受角度，完成时提供实际位置。
方法 method_id可复用的实验步骤，引用所需操作定义和版本。optics.polarization_scan @ 0.1
实验运行 run_id一次提交，记录实验包、参数、样品与所用设备。今天对样品 S1 扫描 0°、15°、30°、45°。
操作实例 operation_id本次运行中的一次实际操作，关联状态、事件与观测。第二点转到 15°，记录实际角度、时间与结束状态。

方法版本说明“按什么做”，run_id 标识“哪次实验”，operation_id 标识“哪次操作”。测量与数据文件沿这些关系保存。
body.en:
method_id + versionOne method can run repeatedly. Each run contains individual operations.
ObjectWhat it describesPolarization-scan example
Instrument and operation descriptionsDevice identity, operation meaning, parameters, units, completion conditions and version.Stage move_to accepts an angle and reports the actual position at completion.
Method: method_idReusable experimental steps that refer to operation definitions and versions.optics.polarization_scan @ 0.1
Experiment run: run_idOne submission, with its package, parameters, sample and equipment.Scan sample S1 at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45°.
Operation instance: operation_idOne actual operation within a run, linked to state, events and observations.At point two, move to 15° and record position, time and completion.

The method version identifies the procedure, run_id the experiment execution, and operation_id an individual operation. Measurements and files retain those links.

title.zh: 同一实验方法的文字与程序表达
title.en: One experimental method for people and software

status.zh: IOP 定义示意 · YAML

body.zh:
人阅读的方法说明

偏振扫描

每个角度先保留转轴、光路与探测器。转台移动与探测器配置可以同时进行，两者完成后采集功率。

角度
单位为度。零点对应波片轴的标定位置。
功率
单位为瓦。记录工作波长与探测器校准引用。
输出
保存实际角度、功率与采集时间，形成同一份扫描记录。
程序读取的同一份定义
method_id: optics.polarization_scan
version: 0.1
requires: {stage: rotation, meter: optical_power}
inputs: {angles_deg: [0, 15, 30, 45]}
context: [plate_axis_zero, wavelength, calibration_ref]
for_each: {angle: angles_deg}
point:
  reserve: [stage.axis, optical_path, meter]
  until: acquire.completed
  steps:
    - {id: move, use: stage.move_to, angle_deg: $angle}
    - {id: setup, use: meter.configure}
    - id: acquire
      after: [move, setup]
      use: meter.measure
  record: [move.angle_actual, acquire.power, acquire.time]

文字与程序引用同一方法版本。转台“完成”的具体条件由操作说明给出，常驻服务等待设备返回到位状态。
body.en:
Method instructions for people

Polarization scan

Reserve the axis, optical path and meter at each angle. Move the stage while configuring the meter, then acquire power after both complete.

Angle
Degrees relative to the calibrated plate-axis origin.
Power
Watts, with wavelength and a detector calibration reference.
Output
Actual angle, power and acquisition time in one scan record.
The same definition for software
method_id: optics.polarization_scan
version: 0.1
requires: {stage: rotation, meter: optical_power}
inputs: {angles_deg: [0, 15, 30, 45]}
context: [plate_axis_zero, wavelength, calibration_ref]
for_each: {angle: angles_deg}
point:
  reserve: [stage.axis, optical_path, meter]
  until: acquire.completed
  steps:
    - {id: move, use: stage.move_to, angle_deg: $angle}
    - {id: setup, use: meter.configure}
    - id: acquire
      after: [move, setup]
      use: meter.measure
  record: [move.angle_actual, acquire.power, acquire.time]

Text and code refer to the same method version. The operation description defines settling, and the service waits for the device to report it.
